{"implementation":"def solve(case):
    payload = case['payload']
    round_scores = payload['round_scores']
    round_targets = payload['round_targets']
    forced = payload['forced']
    N = len(round_scores[0])
    max_idx = N - 1
    forced_set = set(forced)
    for f in forced:
        if not (0 <= f <= max_idx):
            raise ValueError('Forced index out of range')
    active = list(range(N))
    per_round_masks = []
    for i, target in enumerate(round_targets):
        num_forced_active = len(forced_set & set(active))
        if target < num_forced_active:
            raise ValueError('Infeasible target: fewer positions than forced tokens')
        scores = round_scores[i]
        forced_active = [idx for idx in active if idx in forced_set]
        candidates = [idx for idx in active if idx not in forced_set]
        candidates_sorted = sorted(candidates, key=lambda x: scores[x], reverse=True)
        to_keep = target - num_forced_active
        selected = candidates_sorted[:to_keep]
        new_active = forced_active + selected
        new_active.sort()
        mask = [0]*N
        for idx in new_active:
            mask[idx] = 1
        per_round_masks.append(mask)
        active = new_active
    final_retained = active
    return {'masks': per_round_masks, 'final_retained': final_retained}"}
